verdict.rationale: Zulip publishes a public API reference at zulip.com/api with documented endpoints such as Send a message. Its help docs describe an API-based framework for interactive bots, plus a Botserver for production and incoming webhooks, so the core of driving the product programmatically is clearly delivered. The OpenAPI probes found nothing at the common paths, but that shows only that no spec sits at those URLs; it does not contradict the documented API. Missing for 10: evidence of endpoint breadth beyond sending messages (channels, users, search, events), authentication documentation, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
